family.description: Class I PI3Ks are dual-specific lipid and protein kinases involved in numerous intracellular signaling pathways. Class IB PI3K, p110gamma, is mainly activated by seven-transmembrane G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), through its regulatory subunit p101 and G-protein beta-gamma subunits [[cite:PUB00044437]].
family.name: Phosphoinositide 3-kinase gamma adapter protein p101 subunit
